description: §19.16.1 — `defer` is a CONTEXTUAL keyword. A function named `defer` and a call `defer("a")` keep their ordinary meaning (the token after `defer` is `(`, which never opens a defer statement). @got = "called a"; no E-DEFER-* fires.
rationale: §19.16.1: `defer` opens a defer statement only at statement start with a same-line statement lead; `defer(x)` is a call of a function named `defer` (ruling P1: "the word is not at fault").
